title: A lease with a TTL frees itself when its owner crashes
caption: SET NX creates the key only if it is absent; PX makes it expire, so a dead holder can't block everyone forever.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w1 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The key doesn't exist, so it is created: worker 1 holds the lease for 30 s.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The key exists, so NX refuses. Worker 2 backs off and retries.

messages.label: crashes mid-job
messages.note: Worker 1 never sends DEL. Without a TTL the job would be stuck forever.

messages.label: SET lock:job7 w2 NX PX 30000
messages.note: The retry now succeeds and worker 2 takes over the job.
